messages:
jamie_sales: Hey team — got RFP from NovaHealth. They want a capability matrix, answered security questionnaire, and a proposed POC plan. Deadline: EOD Friday. Attachment: NovaHealth_RFP.zip. Anyone can take point?

alex_se: I can own the technical matrix and the POC scope. Need clarity on POC success criteria — is it latency under 200ms p95 for chat and embedding throughput target?

maya_ps: For POC infra we should propose Dedicated (reserved) + a fallback hosted route. I can draft infra diagram and cost delta.

jamie_sales: Good. NovaHealth emphasized data residency and SC-1 SLA. Also asked about encryption at rest and KMS/HSM support. @dinesh_security can you take the security questionnaire?

dinesh_security: Yep, will take the secq. Quick note: they use Azure Gov in one region — we'll need to confirm Private deployment support and KMS integration there. I'll start the questionnaire.

lisa_legal: There's a mutual NDA clause in the RFP appendix. I'll review but can we avoid signing until we confirm SOC2 in scope?

alex_se: Draft capability matrix rows I plan to fill: "Model catalog (open + verified)"; "Streaming & tool-calling"; "KV cache/prefix caching"; "Dedicated capacity SLA"; "VPC/private deployment"; "KMS/HSM integration". Sample matrix snippet below:

```
Feature | Redwood | NovaHealth requirement | Notes
---|---|---|---
VPC/private deployment | Yes | Required | Private control plane + on-prem option
SLA (latency/uptime) | SLA available on Dedicated | SC-1 requested | Can commit on Dedicated contract
KMS/HSM | Customer KMS integrations | Required (Azure Key Vault) | Need AZ Gov compatibility check
Batching/caching | Auto prefix + KV cache | Optional | Reduces token cost
```

jamie_sales: Nice. Can you attach as cap_matrix_v1.xlsx to the thread when ready? They asked for an Excel/CSV.

alex_se: Will upload cap_matrix_v1.xlsx and a short readme. Also proposing a 2-week POC: week 1 integration + perf run, week 2 stress + evals. Pricing draft below:

```
POC proposal:
- Duration: 2 weeks
- Dedicated trial nodes: 2x A100 (or equivalent) reserved for POC
- Cost estimate: $18k for full 2-week reserved capacity (discounted)
- Fallback hosted: pay-as-you-go for overflow
```

maya_ps: FYI infra ask: We should include an ops runbook for failover (fallback to hosted), and a rollback plan for model rollouts. I'll prepare runbook snippet.

jamie_sales: @lisa_legal can you confirm if the NDA in appendix is OK to return with the RFI response? We may need redlines for the indemnity clause.

lisa_legal: I'm on it. Will propose 2 small redlines and aim to return by Thursday AM.

dinesh_security: Starting secq now. Flagging two high-priority Qs: encryption key ownership (customer vs provider) and access logs retention. Will call out required answers and where we need PAM/forensic detail.

alex_se: Also they asked about quantization and model variants for cost control — recommend we include Redwood Optimize suggestions and a short note on recommended quant/latency tradeoffs.

jamie_sales: Timeline recap:
- Today: Alex starts matrix, Maya drafts infra/runbook, Dinesh starts security questionnaire, Lisa reviews NDA.
- Thu AM: Legal redlines returned.
- Thu EOD: cap_matrix_v1.xlsx and secq draft uploaded.
- Fri EOD: Final RFP package submitted to NovaHealth.

deploy-bot: Uploaded file: s3://redwood-sales/NovaHealth/NovaHealth_RFP.zip (contains cap_matrix_v1.xlsx, security_questionnaire_filled_draft.pdf, POC_plan.md) :white_check_mark:

jamie_sales: Perfect — I'll send an interim update to the prospect and ask for any clarifications. Anyone want me to copy specific owners on that email?

alex_se: Please CC me and @dinesh_security for technical and security questions.

maya_ps: CC me for infra/cost details.

jamie_sales: Got it. Thanks all :thumbsup:
